meta.ogDescription: A shared half-day trip from Fes to the cave houses of Bhalil and the old town of Sefrou. From €23pp.

hero.lead: Fes → Bhalil Cave Houses → Sefrou Old Town → Fes

overview.h2: Our cheapest and most local trip
paras: Our cheapest and most local day trip. Bhalil is known for its troglodyte cave houses, some still inhabited today, while Sefrou is a relaxed former capital famous for cherry orchards, pottery, and a walled medina that feels like a smaller, quieter Fes.
At roughly 3.5 hours round trip, this is a great budget add-on alongside a longer day trip or a few days exploring the Fes medina — it wraps up around lunchtime.
chips: 🚗 ≈65 km round trip · about 1.5 hrs driving

includes: Guided visits to Bhalil and Sefrou

paras: Since it wraps up around lunchtime, this pairs well with a free afternoon back in the Fes medina, or as a lower-cost alternative to a full-day trip.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure time, final price, and pickup details by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: Are the Bhalil cave houses still lived in?
items.a: Some are — a few families still occupy homes built into the hillside, and guided visits are respectful, small-group affairs rather than intrusive tourism.

items.q: Is this trip good for a short stay in Fes?
items.a: Yes — at roughly 3.5 hours round trip, it's our shortest full excursion, ideal if you only have a day or two in Fes and want a taste of the wider region.

items.q: Can I buy pottery in Sefrou?
items.a: Yes, Sefrou has a small pottery-making tradition, and the guided stop usually includes a chance to see (and buy from) a local workshop.
